name: webhook-test
title: Webhook Test
description: Stops a webhook from being saved to a URL the sender can't deliver to, by flagging localhost and private IPs, plain http, a missing path and tunnel URLs, then judging a pluggable test delivery the way the sender will: redirects fail (with a one-tap switch to the final URL), slow replies near the timeout and 200 login pages are caught.

meta.stops: Webhook saved to an unreachable URL
